entities.summary: Leader of Ireland (2017–2020, 2022–2024 (Taoiseach)). Fine Gael; first openly gay Taoiseach; first of Indian heritage; youngest Taoiseach ever (38); Brexit negotiations; COVID response; resigned surprisingly March 2024 citing personal reasons
